newsitem.title: UK: UK's M&A surge set to continue -- Candover.
newsitem.headline: UK's M&A surge set to continue -- Candover.

text.p: Britain's heady level of mergers and acquisitions activity could continue over the next five years, according to a survey released on Thursday by investment firm Candover Investments Plc.

The independent survey of 50 of Britain's biggest companies showed that 44 percent planned to make an acquisition within the next year, and 76 percent were likely to do so in the next five-year period.

"Whilst a large number of companies appear to be on the acquisition trail, these deals are likely to reflect a desire for geographic diversification, but still with an industry focus," Candover said in a statement.
The survey was carried out by Numbers Market Research, part of the MORI Group.
